timeline.summary: Fosun Pharma’s **Dorthy Dong** (Board Secretary) declared no share pledges by promoters or PAC for Gland Pharma as of **31-Mar-2026**.
Shareholders reappointed **Ms. Naina Lal Kidwai (DIN: 00017806)** as Independent Director with commission on profits via remote e-voting (86.42% approval).
Gland Pharma posted FY26 revenue of ₹6,430.7 Cr (+14.5%) with Q4 PAT jumping 97% to ₹366.7 Cr and recommended a ₹20/share dividend.
Gland Pharma Limited hosted its Q4 FY26 earnings call on May 15, 2026, at 18:30 IST, with the recording available at https://glandpharma.com/images/Q4_FY26.mp3.
Gland Pharma held its Q4FY26 earnings call, guiding for 12-13% FY27 constant-currency revenue growth and ₹2,000 Cr 5-year capex.
Gland Pharma received four Form 483 observations from the USFDA following an unannounced inspection at its Dundigal formulation facility.
